business_summary: Styrenix Performance Materials Limited engages in the manufacture, trading, and sale of engineering thermoplastics in India. It offers ABS for injection moulding and extrusion use in various applications, such as automobile interiors and exteriors, household appliances, office equipment, and electronic devices for housing; and hight heat ABS used in automotive interior and exterior parts, radiator grills, rear mirror housing, spoilers and wheel covers, air vent, centre fascia, and instrument cluster applications under the ABSOLAC brand. The company also provides styrene acrylonitrile copolymer under the ABSOLAN brand used in industrial goods, stationery, electrical appliances, household applications, and cosmetic jars. In addition, it offers general purpose polystyrene resins, a transparent polymer, which used in TV light diffuser plate, XPS insulation boards, refrigerator drawers, medical labware, PSP and disposable packaging, CD jewel box, and clothes hanger; and high impact polystyrene resin that is used in electronics goods housing, refrigerator in-liner and door liner, refrigerator parts, beverage cups, dairy products packaging, sheets, disposables, yogurt bottles, and toys. Further, the company provides acrylonitrile styrene acrylate under ASALAC the used for outdoor and durable applications; and polycarbonate + acrylonitrile butadiene styrene, a high-performance engineering thermoplastic blend under the STYROLOY brand. The company was formerly known as INEOS Styrolution India Limited and changed its name to Styrenix Performance Materials Limited in January 2023. Styrenix Performance Materials Limited was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Vadodara, India.
